question: Does an activated Sentry education organization show Team plan features, 90 day retention of errors, web API access and a Pay-As-You-Go option under Settings > Subscription, and what plan name does it show?
why: A help article applies the changes listed for Team plans to the education sponsored plan, and the retention table gives the Team plan 90 days for errors. No page names the education plan's own retention of errors, its web API access or its plan name. Only an organization with an activated plan shows them, so each is unverified: behind a sign-up. An account is a step for the operator.
